seo.title: Work with ODD — partnerships, projects and ODDference
seo.description: Bring ODD a question, brief, event or partnership idea. We work across creative practice, cultural context, strategy and production to find the right form for the work.

title: What are you trying to make happen?
intro: Bring us a brief, a question, an event or a partnership idea — including one that is still taking shape. ODD is most useful when the work needs creative and cultural understanding as well as strategy and production.

whenOddIsUseful.headline: Usually when the answer is not just another campaign, event or workshop.

items.title: You have a question but not yet a format.
items.body: We can help frame what the work actually needs before deciding whether the answer is an event, a project, a partnership or something else.

items.title: You need cultural credibility and professional delivery in the same project.
items.body: ODD works inside creative and cultural contexts, but we also build and deliver work with companies, cities and institutions.

items.title: The people who should be involved do not usually work together.
items.body: Sometimes the value is in creating the right conditions, roles and reason for different expertise to sit around the same table.

whatWeDo.headline: We work in the overlap.
whatWeDo.body: ODD runs its own events and its own space, works with artists and cultural organisations, and sells work to companies and institutions. We know those worlds from the inside rather than describing them from a distance — and we build the team around the work instead of around a service catalogue.

pathways.meta: The easiest way to experience ODD
pathways.title: ODDference
pathways.body: The easiest way to experience ODD professionally. Come yourself, bring colleagues, or build something around the event with us.

pathways.title: ODDnetwork
pathways.body: A year-round way to stay involved beyond one event or project. We are still shaping it with the first organisations taking part — including what it is finally called.

pathways.meta: For ODDference, ODDfest, ODDspace and beyond
pathways.title: Partnerships
pathways.body: Bring resources, expertise or an idea into ODDference, ODDfest, ODDspace or another ODD context when there is a clear reason to build something together.

pathways.meta: A concrete brief, question or idea
pathways.title: ODDagency
pathways.body: For briefs and questions that need cultural understanding, creative conception and a project-specific team.

contact.title: What are you trying to make happen?
contact.body: Tell us the situation in your own words. You do not need to know which ODD route fits; we can work that out together.
